concerns.text: T002 (config.yaml) is sequenced AFTER T001, yet T002's verification requires that '02_ingest_data.py and 03_clean_merge.py' read config.yaml with 'no hard-coded URLs/seeds in those scripts' — the very scripts T001 completes. Implementing T001 first forces either hard-coded endpoints in T001 (violating T002's check) or rework of T001's scripts in T002. Swap the order: T002 (config) before T001 (ingestion/clean), matching the foundational-tasks-first principle.
